name: anim_hira_walk
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls, a spiky dripping brown and cream mane, wide-open eyes and a toothy grin, straight human legs with bare human feet
desc: A confident, swaggering heavy walk: a full walk cycle in place with two clear steps, keeping the same three-quarter view as the first frame: the body never turns sideways. Clear strides with the feet well apart: first the near leg swings forward and plants its foot in front while the far leg pushes off behind, then the legs pass each other, then the far leg swings forward and plants in front while the near leg is behind, then they pass again. The legs never cross. The opposite arm swings forward with each step, the body bobs 2 or 3 pixels up and down, the mane strands bounce. The body does not move across the frame. The face keeps the same wide-eyed toothy grin. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
